title: The Kettle That Bargains in Steam
story: Halfway up the volcano, Scaldwyn squats over the healing hot springs and refuses to let the mountain village fill a single flask until someone mixes his Soothing Brew correctly. The recipe is strict: 3 parts moonwater to 5 parts ember sap, and the village needs 96 flasks of brew in all. Moonwater is free from the spring — but ember sap must be bought from the lava-farmers at 2.5 ember coins a flask.
question: How many ember coins must Mr 6 pay for the ember sap needed to make all 96 flasks?
solution: The ratio 3 : 5 makes 3 + 5 = 8 parts, so one part is 96 / 8 = 12 flasks.
Ember sap is 5 parts: 5 × 12 = 60 flasks of sap.
praise: Splitting the recipe into ratio parts was the clever heart of this one — the missing step was multiplying those sap flasks by the 2.5-coin price.
hint: How many equal parts does a 3 : 5 recipe have in total, and how big is one part out of 96?
victory: Mr 6 pours the brew in perfect proportion and Scaldwyn whistles with delight, handing over the springs forever — he only ever wanted someone to take the recipe seriously.
imagePrompt: A steaming giant kettle-shaped creature with a spout for a mouth hunched over glowing volcanic hot springs while a small numeral-6 knight measures two colored liquids into a flask, warm orange light and rising steam.
